clusters.name: Clear guidance on market fall investments
clusters.description: Users need actionable advice and reassurance on whether to withdraw or continue investing when the market drops.
examples: A simple and clear user interface to track investments and terms.
Information on recommended time horizons for SIP investments.
Clear reassurance on what happens to investments if the brokerage app shuts down.
Alternative payment reminder methods when lacking debit cards or net banking.
Accurate calculation of invested amount, profit/loss, and XIRR after making partial withdrawals.

clusters.name: Clear guidance on SIP rules and returns
clusters.description: Users need straightforward instructions and explanations regarding SIP investments, returns, tax rules, and management features.
examples: Clear instructions on how to withdraw or redeem SIP investments.
Needed a simple UI with straightforward fund insights and basic SIP management features.
Clear information on tax rules and exit loads when withdrawing from an SIP.
Clear guidance on how to calculate returns for stopped SIPs that are still holding units.
Needed guidance on why the SIP is in total loss after 2 years.

clusters.name: Clear and simple metrics display
clusters.description: Users need straightforward dashboard metrics and performance views to easily understand their investments.
examples: The user needed a clear and intuitive way to cancel their SIP.
User needed detailed individual SIP performance views instead of only gross invested amounts.
User needed to know how to resume an SIP after a failed instalment due to low balance.
The user needed a clear end-to-end explanation of the withdrawal procedure and tax implications after SIP completion.
User needed a functional goal-tracking interface that correctly maps portfolios to goals.

clusters.name: Guidance on choosing the right mutual fund
clusters.description: Users need clear recommendations, comparisons, and criteria to select suitable mutual fund schemes for their goals.
examples: Information on specific bank mutual fund offerings.
User needed recommendations on which mutual fund to choose for starting an SIP.
User needs validation on whether starting a mutual fund through a friend's broker is the right choice.
Needed a clear way to track portfolio performance and guidance on handling losses in SBI equity mutual fund.
Demonstration on how to redeem or sell mutual fund units.

clusters.name: Clarity on SIP mechanics and returns
clusters.description: Users need straightforward explanations regarding how SIP calculations, returns, charges, and payment processes work.
examples: Clarity on return calculations when buying market dips.
Needed clarity on how returns are calculated and what exact payout to expect.
Needed clarity on how SIP calculator projections work.
Needed clarity on auto-pay options and risk warning messages while investing.
Needed clarity on where the redemption amount is credited after completing an SIP tenure.

clusters.name: Understand complex financial returns and metrics
clusters.description: Users need plain-language explanations of confusing metrics like XIRR, NAV, deductions, and annualized returns.
examples: Clear explanation of deductions and final payout compared to accumulated value.
Clear explanation of why invested value decreases during market dips.
Clear explanation of the first payment vs scheduled installment date cycle.
Clear explanation of why XIRR is negative despite a positive NAV.
The user needed a clear explanation of what a -100 XIRR reading means on their mutual fund SIP.

clusters.name: Guidance and clarity on choosing mutual funds
clusters.description: Users need reliable information, beginner guides, and clear comparisons to confidently select and manage their mutual funds.
examples: Peer opinions and reviews on specific mutual funds.
Needs a beginner-friendly guide or video on how to start investing in mutual funds from scratch.
Clarification on expense ratio differences between direct and regular funds.
Clear indicators or labels within the app for IDCW versus growth mutual funds.
Simple guide or direct feature to transfer existing mutual funds between brokers.

clusters.name: See positive returns after investing for years
clusters.description: Users want to achieve positive investment returns and avoid losses after holding their investments for multiple years.
examples: Needed positive returns after 2 years of investing instead of losses.
Positive returns after more than two years of investing.
Calculations showing returns adjusted for inflation and taxes
Positive returns after 3 years of investing.
Positive returns immediately instead of showing a loss.

clusters.name: Validation and review of portfolio diversification
clusters.description: Users need assurance and guidance on their fund selection and portfolio diversification to ensure balanced investments.
examples: Needed timely portfolio value updates and external MF tracking without switching apps.
Guidance on portfolio diversification vs having too many small SIPs.
Clear and consistent portfolio display showing accumulated investments instead of single installments.
Needed validation on portfolio diversification across six sectors.
Needed validation on fund selection to ensure portfolio is properly diversified.

clusters.name: Guidance on long-term investing strategy
clusters.description: Users need advice, clarity, and recommendations on how to plan, select funds, and manage investments for long-term financial goals.
examples: Adequate wealth creation after long-term investing.
Needs a recommendation or guidance on fund selection for a long-term 20-year SIP.
Interface guidance on how to set or view long-term tenure calculators.
Guidance on how to invest for children's long-term future.
Clear steps on how to redeem mutual funds after a long term.

clusters.name: Reliable systems and responsive customer support
clusters.description: Users need dependable app functionality coupled with fast, helpful customer support to resolve issues quickly.
examples: Needed accurate portfolio tracking matching MF Central and prompt customer support.
User needed transparent deduction matching invested amounts and responsive customer support.
The user needed accurate settlement timelines and responsive customer support.
Timely account verification and responsive customer support.
Flexible SIP frequencies like quarterly SIPs and better customer support.

clusters.name: Free Portfolio Tracking Without Paywalls
clusters.description: Users need free, unrestricted access to portfolio tracking, analytics, and management tools without being forced into paid subscriptions.
examples: Free tracking of external mutual fund portfolios.
Needed a frictionless way to cancel SIPs and free access to features without paywalls.
Free portfolio tracking and mutual fund analysis features without paywalls.
Free portfolio tracking and visibility without paid subscriptions.
Needed free viewing and management of external mutual funds without subscription charges.

clusters.name: Guidance on choosing specific investment funds
clusters.description: Users need clear recommendations and help selecting the right funds or asset types to start investing.
examples: Needed guidance on where to invest small pocket money as a beginner.
Needed a way to invest without fixed commitments during delayed client payments.
The user needed guidance on how to select the right mutual fund to invest in.
Unable to execute a one-time top-up in a small cap fund.
Guidance on selecting between two specific flexi cap funds before starting.

clusters.name: Guidance to start investing and SIPs
clusters.description: Users need clear, step-by-step guidance on how to begin investing and set up their first SIP safely.
examples: Needed a trustworthy investment platform recommendation to start investing.
Guidance for beginners and NRI laborers wanting to start investing safely.
Help in choosing the right platform to start investing.
Guidance on which fund is the best to start a first-time SIP.
Guidance on how to choose the right mutual fund to start an SIP.
